payload.text:
The prospect has provided the sizing info and is clearly fatigued. I need to:
1. Provide pricing for their 50+ agents, 5K tickets/month, email + chat
2. Ask ZERO questions per the policy
3. Update deal properties with the new sizing info

For email + chat, Suite Growth ($89/agent/month) is the minimum tier that supports both channels.
I've drafted the response and updated the deal properties. Now I need to log the email draft to HubSpot.

bodyParts.intro: Thank you for the details. With 50+ agents needing both email and chat, the Suite Growth tier at $89 per agent/month is the right fit. Per the published Zendesk catalog pricing, that includes the core features you need to get your support operations running smoothly.
